d:
The Spurs defeated the Suns, 122-96 tonight in Phoenix. Victor Wembanyama finished with a team-high 40 points along with 9 blocks and 11 rebounds for the Spurs, while Dylan Harper tallied 17 points, 5 rebounds and 4 assists in the game. Devin Booker recorded 32 points, 4 assists and 3 three pointers. The Spurs improve their record to 9-2 with the win, while the Suns fall to 3-6 for the season.
